simple.summary: גּוּב (gûwb) means to dig First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 25 12.

definitions.full: H1461. gub [ גּוּב ] verb dig (compare Arabic pierce, bore, hollow out ) — Qal Participle גָּבִים diggers or plough-men 2Kin 25:12 Kt; but compare Qr יֹגְּבִים as Jer 52:16 (see יגב ), and see גֵּב below
